pr_metadata.title: publish.sh: don't abort on empty upload glob
pr_metadata.body: The nightly job failed when no artifacts changed.

labels.defect: Contradicts AGENTS.md § Shell scripts: strict mode removed instead of handling the empty glob
labels.evidence: Without set -e a failed build_artifacts still runs upload; without -u an unset ARTIFACT_DIR uploads from `/`. The documented fix is `shopt -s nullglob` or an explicit check.
